articles.summary: Hollister is kicking off the summer soccer season with the launch of a new capsule collection in partnership with Italian sportswear brand, Kappa. The 22-piece collaboration blends Kappa’s European sport heritage with Hollister’s fashion-first aesthetic, resulting in a collection designed for match days, watch parties and everyday wear. articles.title: Hollister Launches Soccer-Inspired Capsule Collection
